reviewMethod: Seventeen previously unreviewed body figures across five current-corpus papers were independently reviewed from immutable read-only GitHub evidence artifact 10785035374, following publication-date priority with JACS first at equal priority. Each approval was checked against current corpus demand, DOI-bound page/article/source provenance, original figure/scheme identity and independent caption, exact frozen bytes/full SHA256 and evidence fingerprint, media generation 1790082000000, image role, article theme, visual clarity, and duplicate/TOC-substitution risk. SVG files were rendered and checked for active/external content; the PNG decoded at its stored dimensions. Figure 1 items are explicitly body figures, never TOC replacements. For JACS 10.1021/jacs.6c05496 and 10.1021/jacs.6c10408, later article-level capture reports remained partial and include transport/stage failures; those reports are treated only as provenance/history, approval is limited to the exact already stored DOI-bound files, and no VPN/R2/quota cause is inferred. No publisher recrawl, R2/D1 write, server-side direct import/repair, literature-data change, userscript change, quarantine-generation change, or production deployment is authorized by this packet.
